My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

I experienced the best customer service at Skopje Airport During security I found out that my phone was missing I left my phone at the selfservice check in machine on the other side of security But they helped me out They called their colleagues and eventually found it brought it back to me I felt trustful through the whole process and really really het Thanks a lot

The airport is small yet very well organized There is every service available that a person would require even for a long wait restaurant ATMs banks PO as far as airport seats go I was able to sleep on these in more comfort than others Ive been through many airports and can honestly say that Im impressed

From the city to the airport in minutes The new terminal is fine Beautiful geometric lines used in the design Checkin for flight did not take too long The old building renovated and converted into a zone of local flights There are many shops and cafes There was a small queue of precontrol before departure

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

I cant remember when the last time I was here but nevertheless it was a pleasant surprise to use the airport again Many places to have food and the atmosphere was pleasant Just one thing that I disliked was the toilet in the common area It was really smelly and should be dealt with immediately

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

We had quite a lot of time to kill in this airport and it didnt disappoint There was a restaurant right in the middle of the terminal that was delicious and decently priced Unfortunately the wifi was not working no matter how many times we tried but they had this nice area called the library we sat in that was pleasant and helped the time pass

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone
There is very good food and Wifi Internet The dutyfree shop has all kinds of brands and it is cheaper than neighboring countries The immigration inspection is fast and not difficult

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much
Good airport no delays it was fairly quiet when I travelled Security and passport checks all done efficiently Staff were polite and helpful

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania

Haneda is a nice airport but immigration is hell long lines clearly show the Japanese slowness to adapt to any increase of the of arrival If you fly in while low traffic It is one of the best airport but not today as I will be losing minutes to pass immigration

The little airport is getting a lot more traffic and starting to burst at the seams Even though the rail connection is a good piece of news the amount of people in the transit area isnt But still it beats Stansted queuing and even Ryanair checkin is fairly straight forward
Little airport very nice Not many dining choices not very important for me because it was a late flight Fast boarding procedure Pleasant view of the tarmac
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge
Very good airport Satisfied with all aspects of airport Best airport in Kerala Lots of new shops are opening on the airport I am sure this airport will make to top airports in India

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

Well organised for the transit process Airport service persons picked us up at the exit and allocated us in a special area There are free services for water wifi access and breakfast A lady registers and reminds each of the customers in the waiting area for boarding Very good experience

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

Wenzhou Airport is for me one of best airports in China The New terminal is very big and very beautiful the checkin security check and boarding is fast and easy At this airport they start the automatic checkin and it is fantastic and very simple The airport staff are kind and happy to serve you
The new terminal is really fresh and at the domestic departure some airlines merge in the same area and you can check in at any queue Everything looks good

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by
I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

This was a ok flight At the airport my bag got stuck on the baggage belt and then a worker hit it really hard but thankfully I had nothing that fragile in it When we were boarding there was a delay because a seat was stuck reclined and they had to bring an engineer onboard The flight was very smooth and the cabin crew were very nice although not as nice as their biggest competitor Ryanair The landing was really good and the pilot kept giving us information about the flight

Cascais to Bragana with Aero VIP Services are provided by SevenAir The site is easy I had a couple of questions and the support was fantastic The plane was just fine despite being a propeller thus a bit noisy

Flew AR on various segments in November Rio de Janeiro GIG to Buenos Aires Buenos Aires Puerto Madryn rt and Buenos Aires Barilcohe rt using both AEP and EZE in Buenos Aires Pleasant experience on all flights All flights departed on time boarding process was well organized crews were courteous and complimentary drinks and a snack were served in economy No issues with checked luggage Would certainly fly them again

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Excellent flight good service with hearty meal starter main course dessert tea and coffee Duty service on board A generous pitch for economy class seats Note the delay at departure due to the closure of Orly airport and the flights diverted to Paris CDG

My first experience with this regional airline on a short hop from PointaPietre to Melville Hall Very pleasant and relaxed flight nice staff and decent leg and hand luggage space Will be happy to fly with them at any time again

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

Paris to Reunion Air Austral is a fairly good airline The seat layout of the Airbus A was xx The leg room was not too bad Inflight entertainment was good and worked well Cabin service was average but generally fine The flight was on time

Flew internal flights in Burma with this local airline Surprisingly new plane pretty much on time and with very pleasant crews Also served a good snack gave out towels although flights were only about minutes Was a bit reticent about using them but very pleasantly surprised

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

Apart from the fact that the crew at Incheon were a little rude everything was perfect For a low cost airline the seats were very comfy and the legroom was amazing I would definitely recommend this airline

Reykjavik to Akureyri I have never been on a friendlier serviced aircraft than this Absolutely wonderful flight only minutes and quite a unique experience on a propeller plane Absolutely love the onboard travel journal where you can read other passengers adventures and write your own in very sweet Would love to fly with them again next time Im in Iceland

Milan to Male Nice airline Very good in all services Economy class is a very good class Beverages are very good too with a lot of product On my flight services were snack lunch and a afternoon snack with a slice of pizza If you need something else you can ask to steward that will help you in every moment Staff is very kind and happy Good airline

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

Heho to Yangon Another very good flight same ATR aircraft no seat numbers given but all very easy boarding Plenty of space seating and inflight snacks given with coffee or Tea One member of crew not happy but not the end of the world At I had no problem with the seat space in fact better than many European airlines

Pyongyang to Beijing with hotcold drinks and a hamburger which was adequate for length of flight Very polite and welcoming service Efficient check in and boarding In flight entertainment limited to a video of recent North Korean hits Pyongyang Times and Korea Today available to take on board

Easy check in at Gatwick They use the club rooms lounge which was fine Prompt boarding and beverage served One hour delay managed well by crew who served further drinks and snacks During flight beverage good There is a strong emphasis on fish in meals It was fine I just dont like fish Slept well on lie flat mattress topper was very good Breakfast good their orange juice was excellent Easy disembarking and luggage off quickly
The aircraft was on time from Manchester and on the return journey from Lourdes Bartres the aircraft left early The staff were a bit distant the food good overall OK
A decent enough job on a very full flight They got me there from A to B without frills or fuss I liked the onboard Kiwi Qui that they ran during the flight a nice and quirky touch

Air New Zealand short haul is brilliant The crew service was brilliant There was also a quiz on the plane for the whole flight Very quick flight time after the plane was late coming in from the previous destination Brilliant quick flight
The airline was fantastic Left and arrived on time You get a snack provided by the airline Very tasty Would always choose to fly with Air North in the future

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

Panama City to David Pleasant flight experience on an old Fokker A little expensive for what you get but theres little competition in Panama Seats were comfortable spacious though the interior of the plane had not seen an update since the late s or early s Cabin crew were friendly and served soft drinks including diet options and plantain chips Flight departed and arrived about min late

Amazing team at Hubli airport We had to change the plane in Bangalore to get to Kochi and we might be late however the team assured us that our baggage will go first from plane when we have landed Us and few other people in similar situation were brought by small bus faster than other customer to the airport and one guy from airport in Bangalore from Air Pegasus made sure and check our flights details that we will be on time Thank you one more time especially for team in Hubli Amazing customer service

Living and working in South Africa I fly home to Zimbabwe fairly often and try to be patriotic and use the national airline I have only been delayed once in the past year Food is good and service also of acceptable standards Ggetting through to the Joburg offices is another story altogether overall I think Air ZIm are doing the best they can with the resources at their disposal

I would like to write about the splendid service given to me my spouse by Air Asia AK Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar on Friday Im so proud to mention about these two cabin crew Ms Camelia Mr Amirul Their love and care is still lingering in our mind Kudos to Air Asia to have them in their crew family Our most sincerest gratitude Love you guys a lot our best wishes in your future
Special appreciation to the cabin crew Sonika I was super impressed with her fluency in announcements all three different languages and it was just amazing to hear her out
Airline staff helped me with last minute web check in cancellation also helped locating the luggage and provided the best support and service for such hospitality and customer delight
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky
I was super impressed with this airline Highly recommend it for travel within Africa Im not sure what else to say Glad airlink is available now for travel in Africa
Everything about the flight experience went well I was worried reading the other reviews but in the end it was a very positive experience The terminal in El Nido is also very good

From the moment I boarded the crew exuded warmth and professionalism Junu and Reeza provided assistance wherever needed The inflight service was impeccable Bhoomi and Nisha managed the meal service efficiently The crew went above and beyond to ensure passenger comfort Whether it was providing extra blankets assisting with luggage or attending to special requests they were attentive and proactive Their kindness and willingness to help truly stood out Looking forward to flying with Akasa Air again

Cusco to Uyuni via La Paz My experience with Amaszonas was good actually Luckily the weather was in my favor too Initially I was a little skeptical after reading reviews but the trip was pretty smooth Flight was on the smaller side although not as small as people had initially mentioned Theres about to rows of seats and I was comfortable THe only thing is they board like minutes prior to departure which makes you a little nervous but the trip as such was okay

I had a fantastic experience on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines The flight departed on time and despite being only minutes the service was exceptional We were offered a predeparture beverage and even a full beverage service once airborne a rare treat for such a short flight As someone who takes this route twice a week Ive consistently been impressed with the professionalism and efficiency of the crew

My recent minute flight from DCA to PHL operated by PSA Airlines for American Eagle was a pleasant experience Despite a minor delay while waiting for the crew to arrive from another flight the service was good We were offered a predeparture beverage and even received beverage service during the short flight a nice touch for such a brief journey The CRJ proved to be more comfortable than the CRJ making the quick trip enjoyable For such a short flight theres truly nothing to complain about

I was traveling for work to and from Amsterdam to Samos I was seated on the first row with even for the B a lot of space for my legs Slept almost the whole time so for me this was a perfect flight Cabin crew were very professional

AMSAUAAMS I regularly fly ArkeFly between Europe and the Antilles and what a huge difference between the old and worn with barely enough space to breathe and the new with more spacious seats PTV and a so much better experience Furthermore the crew seems to enjoy the Dreamliner much more and even smiles are being made Also the time of always being delayed also seems to be over ArkeFly improved a lot with the Dreamliner and I even prefer Arkefly above KLM now as long as they fly the Dreamliner
I just experienced Asiana Airlines Business class food delicious flight attendants good service I give stars because flight is delay minutes and does not have wiFi

Small company but very friendly and efficient staff All passengers treated as business class travelers even though Atlantic Airways only offers one class economy Small planes Bea and Airbus but the comfort is all right for the short trips between Scandinavian countries Faroe Islands and Britain
CPHFAE return new aircraft on time friendly and smiling FA snack alcoholic nonalcoholic beverage served

Da Nang to Da Lat The checkout process was smooth Although there was a minutes delay due to the late arrival of the airplane once we boarded everything went on well The legroom was not that cramped I found the crew service even better than Vietnam Airlines flight I flew to Da Nang several days before So I might fly this airline again on my future visit to Vietnam
Superb flight Left on time and arrived early This typifies the reason why Bangkok Airways is world best regional airline You got a little bag with a sandwich and water which was tasty
Quite amazing that Bangkok Airways manages to serve a warm meal with drinks and coffee on a minutes full flight free of charge Even though the food wasnt very special but still edible it impressed me

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air and I found this airline to be brilliant in all aspects Their prices are phenomenal and I couldnt complain about anything Check in was super fast and done with a smile The plane is a little outdated but its still new and growing The flight itself was mins and for such a short flight you even got a complimentary drink

The flights are frequently delayed but its a small price to pay for clean aircraft ample seat pitch kind crew and the lowest fares My flight from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur was on an A with plenty of legroom and good meals Online checkin yields a good seat for me and their use of KLIA T makes for an easy and relaxing journey

I take this airline from Hangzhou to Lisbon th May The food is good taste and various I have stony insomnia problem and i did not pay attention and lost my sleeping medicine into rubbish I told the air hostess she is warmheart and patiently helped me search the rubbish patiently almost taking hours and finally searched my sleeping medicine I am thankful for this

Overall quite satisfied with this flight The service of the flight attendants was very good very attentive and thoughtful which made me feel their attentiveness and warmth The cabin seats were a bit hard the entertainment system was partially out of order the movie selection was relatively small the route was long and there werent enough movies to watch I am quite satisfied with everything else and would recommend this airline to my friends
Kuala Lumpur to Pangkor Island return This is the most pleasant way of flying for those who love airplanes

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service

Flew from Lisbon to Las Palmas on th December Wasnt exactly sure what to expect from such a small airline The CRJ plane was fine albeit somewhat dated Service on board was very efficient with a nice spread of snacks for a hm flight I would definitely fly with them again A good airline
Short trip Arlanda to Helsinki Very nice people working on board Cold but nice meal nice experience

I hope Boutique Air continues this service to altoona I have been able to get my mother who lives in Altoona back and forth to Pittsburgh for medical treatment and advanced care she needs The drive to Pittsburgh is atrocious and I hope boutique continues this route for a very long time A total life saver and an awesome experience Out of about flights i have taken only have been delayed and very short about minutes or so Their customer service is outstanding and always so friendly

I cannot say enough how much I enjoyed this airline experience From the check in counter to the TSA at the local tiny airport to the pilots It is totally a different way of flying commercial and just so much more personal I wish more routes were like this because its such a nice experience My flight was also minutes early on arrival which allowed me to get to my next gate with ease Thank you Boutique Air and hope to fly you again some day Maybe there will be wifi next time

Baku to Kiev with Buta Airways I have to say after travelling for years this was definitely the best Low Cost Carrier I have ever flown with On time and sharp Plus you get free water and a free sandwich But saying that for a ml beer is and a pizza Incredible value you money I had flown them for a min flight so was interested to see what a hour flight would be like But it was absolutely perfect

FCOTSRIAS Business Class Checkin in FCO terrible just counter minutes waiting time No lounge offered Inflight service with very friendly and attentive staff good food Transit in TSR as well despite of being a small and old airport was ok Here again very polite staff

Wuhan to Hong Kong Overall the experience was wonderful The flight was delayed for around one hour and meal was provided at the gate The meal was even better than those served in cabin on many Chinese domestic airlines flights Cabin crew were nice and friendly

I would like to give a commendation to the staff of Cebu Pacific working at the Roxas City airport who helped my father recover his lost luggage which was mistakenly picked up by another passenger These people worked hard and I have also witnessed all the efforts they made to give all the help that we needed Thank you for your hard work and dedication You guys are awesome
Tried Premium Economy class and I was surprised about the seat quality and onboard meals This class also included amenity kit which I appreciate Cabin crew nicely handle my yo child

London City to Dublin The website is easy to use Checkin and boarding were well organised Staff neatly dressed and and welcoming A drink is included in the cost of the ticket as well as a small snack Departed on time and arrived on time too A very pleasant short flight

Very short min flight to Zanzibar and back again from Dar es Salaam with Coastal Aviation Both flights were on time and our luggage arrived too Tiny aircraft and fully booked so quite a squeeze but comfortable enough for such a short flight Was very pleasantly surprised with the punctuality and reliability Would definitely recommend flying Coastal

On the plane the staff hardly gave us any water and the water tasted like the plastic cup it was in I am not surprised if anyone got dehydrated The legroom was good and the seat was okay Overall it was okay I wouldnt recommend it

There are a lot of negative reviews for this airlines but for a budget airline what do these reviewers expect Premium airline service They have obviously never flown on EasyJet or Ryanair to make a comparison Flew to Turkey from Manchester and was quite impressed by their checkin service and legroom on the plane Recommend to anyone
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again

Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

It was five and half hours flight They served only one breakfast After that they didnt offer anything unless we asked for a snack or drinks They should have offered another light meal two hours after breakfast Otherwise everything is perfect
Perfect flight Good breakfast Feel safe Flight attendants were very professional They take care of you All was perfect

A lowcost airline and they enforce bag weights and sizes and number of bags very closely Despite that if you buy early its a good value for travel in and around Kazakhstan Purchase bags early as they charge a lot at airport My flight however was fine arrived on time with no issues Overall satisfied for what I paid

Business classenjoyed a drink of champagne and some refreshments upon taking a seat and theres plenty of room to stretch out Particularly on their trips from Dubai An amazing collection of Englishlanguage movies spanning every possible genre
Always on time Professional cabin crew Perfect weather and an overall pleasant flight Thank you FlySafair

We had a great flight with French Bee from Paris back to NYC We booked late for our first ever Europe trip so we didnt want to buy expensive tickets We took a risk going with French Bee since its cheap about one way We were nervous seeing all the bad reviews especially with cancellations Turned out to be an awesome experience on time good foods no turbulence

Dusseldorf to Berlin Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings EW Flight had a slight delay of minutes Flight was smooth and good Seat was fine with enough legroom Food and drinks for puchase crew was just average

Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

I took GOL twice for domestic flights during a recent trip to Brazil I chose the extra legroom seats which were available for a reasonable surcharge and offered plenty of legroom Overall the flights were comfortable and on time All passengers were offered a small snack and a drink I would choose GOL again

Always a pleasure to fly with Swiss safety comes first with them then the comfort On my flight back to Switzerland from Bucharest I had such a nice experience thanks to Paul who attended the business class passengers I felt like I am flying first Class because of his service
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

Thank you to the flight attendants of flight hx today Monday the th I left my phone in my seat on my flight and my phone made it to my next gate very quickly because the staff not only were wonderful but they care enough to not just put my phone in a box I thank you from the bottom of my heart

I fly with IB express a few times a month Usually on time or even ahead of schedule Service on board is really good Welcome drink online entertainment full meal service with really nice food Drinks available during all flight I truly recommend them Only issue the comfort of the seat If you fly the old seat comfort nonexistent no headrest no recline If you fly the new Aneo seats are comfy for a hr flight to the Canary Islands they do recline and have headrest Good service for a low cost airline
I travelled from Istanbul to Bangkok via Delhi service was good as compared to low the fare and staff behavior is also very good but for extra luggage they charge extra money

Flew Stockholm to Tehran with Iran Air I had good flight with the new fleet of this airline minute delay but the cabin was new and clean with good seat distance and very tasty food Iranian film and music and route information was provided I recommend flying with Iran Air on international routes because of the nice cabin and good meals for the value of money

We had a very good experience flying with Island Air The day we took our return flight they were celebrating their th anniversary We were greeted with lei greeting before boarding the flight On the flight we were given some local cookies local coffee and POG juice The flight attendants were nice I was not expecting good customer service as I read some bad reviews but it was a pleasant experience overall

Bought a ticket around the world and finally I could try the JAL one of the Japanese airlines My trip was sublime I rate this as the best airline Cabin Crew were outstanding food was delicious wine are perfect As its Japanese it has the automatic toilets on board too Seat comfy Got rest got cocooned and now I know who to fly with

Our outbound flight was delayed which caused us to miss our connecting flight to Toronto with another airline The delay was due to a late inbound flight This created a small issue in Montreal but the other airline was able to get us on a later flight The flight itself was uneventful Service on board was good flight attendants were fantastic and friendly

Brussels to Casablanca on Jetairfly and everything was great The price wasnt too expensive there were no delays and the staff were polite and professional Only negative point is the leg space but thats okay for less than hours in my opinion I will fly with them again

Apart from a minute delay outbound it is hard to fault my SydneyAdelaide return trip Yes its a no frills carrier but most everything worked efficiently and I was impressed by how smiling and happy all the staff were

I want to express my sincere thanks to Jin Air staff in Osaka I had a flight from Osaka to Seoul in May and had not completed the Keta for this reason I could not board However the checkin staff did everything possible to help me complete the documentation Despite not having completed it on time I missed my flight even so the staff offered me an available seat on the next flight I really value this collaboration I hope the staff is notified about this Thank you so much

Seoul to Okinawa I was very impressed my Jin Air employee that was working at gate Seoul ICN February I first told him that I needed a seat assignment and he recognized me first off by my name I was really impressed by his professionalism and mannerism

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai

Competent and efficient flights Delay in Geneva handled well captain came to boarding gate to explain Comfort seats had good leg room even on a A sandwich and drink served on each flight of just over an hour

Superb This is by far the best business class product within Europe The meal was one of the best Ive eaten Cabin crew delightful Wine servings enormous and just nothing to correct in the product It is a shame that no other European airline comes close to this standard

I took KE from HKG to ICN in July As I have already known that it was a top airline I had high expectations on it The ground service was very good The seat was quite wide and the cabin crew were very polite The food was average but not many movies to watch Although it was delayed for two hours I think the whole experience is worth the price
Amazing flight even the fact that it was slightly delayed The food was good and the quilty of the staff was high The cabin was clean

The cabin crew were amazing They really took control of the cabin and looked after all the passengers The thing Ive never seen is how they controlled the disembarking of the plane ensuring specific rows would get up in an orderly fashion Ive flown Kulula for over a decade and theyve really upped their game

As a frequent flyer on the Kuwait Airways I would recommend it on there large aircrafts such as Ber Aneo or A and specially on business class even though it is expensive but you will get a good quality service My rating would be on there business first and royal class And I have also uploaded a photo of Ber business seat

A comfortable nononsense flight which was delayed by about minutes while departing but made up for most of the time difference by the time one landed The crew was courteous and professional the seating comfortable and there was a snack service consisting of a packet of Lays Chips and a Juice which was quite ok for the short flight The luggage arrival was also fuss free and ontime Overall quite a nice flight

This was an unexpected surprise due to my family thinking that we were going to fly Ryanair however in my opinion it was a pleasant surprise I have a really bad fear of flying so an incredibly nice cabin crew member sat next to me and told me that she loved flying and how long she had done it for and how safe it was She also said that she really enjoyed flying and the turbulence was enjoyable The seats were nice and the crew was amazing I didnt get any food but I loved this low cost airline

TIPBEN on a nearly new Canadair regional jet with leather seats and decent pitch Very happy with the short flight New terminals are being built at both ends sorely needed Otherwise would fly them again

Manchester to Tripoli Airbus A Plane was a little old and tired looking Only passengers on board and I was the only one in Business Class Seats were OK food was fine The flight took off on time and arrived in Tripoli on time Based on costs and timings this was very good value compared to British Airways
Simply fantastic what an experience A very time and cost efficient way to travel in Scotland heres hoping they add more routes soon

Its been seven years since I last flew on Lufthansa I was fortunate enough to fly on Lufthansa for the first time in seven years and the moment I got on that plane I felt good Because it was a short flight I didnt have to worry about anything But the best part was that I got a Milk Chocolate bar from Lindt and whats nice is that they have a Lufthansa logo on it what a finishing touch
We loved Lynx It was Super affordable planes were on time and no delays We dont eat on planes anyway so who cares Will definitely be flying again

Hong Kong to Kahsioung A quite nice flight It was my first time flying an Embraer jet I know it is small but the seat is comfortable and wide A delicious hot meal was served in a mins flight The crew is friendly and fluent in English The only bad thing is that the flight was delayed for hours

The meals were very good and the portions generous The crew were efficient and were on time both ways Seating assignments seemed ambiguous but my family of four ended up with one window seat on return to Vancouver from Amsterdam which was a nice surprise None of my children had any complaint throughout the two long journeys and that would be the measure of a pleasant flight experience by my standards I would fly with Martinair again in future

The best airline I have tried till now The best pilots they are very competent The service is good Delicious food Im proud to be Lebanese and to have such a company The tickets are expensive but its worth it

ChisinauBudapest roundtrip Both departures on time Served breakfast on the way out and lunch inbound Luggage transfer handled efficiently despite relatively short connection time in Budapest SAAB plane offers plenty of legroom and is not so noisy compared to other prop planes Friendly FAs and my favourite option for flights from Moldova to Europe

I chose this airline for the simple reason of its aircraft type Boarding was completed quickly for on time departure On board seat pitch was a little tight snack service box was offered water and a sweet coffee bun and a sales trolley after that Cabin was quite warm and no walk though by cabin crew offering water Cabin is showing it age for sure but still enjoyed my flight
Nepal Airlines is a cheap option for direct flights from Nepal with good service Nepal Airlines improved its service over time The cabin crew were professional and meal served was good

We took Flight from Kathmandu to Bangkok by Nepal airlines for our Holiday trip Flight was on time meal provided during flight is delicious and have veg and non veg options Staff of airline were well behaved and professional I will use service of Nepal in future as well Highly recommended
Flight was on time food provided is very good and warm They did provide us window seat while boarding Its good idea to try Nepal Airlines for onward journey if you are traveling fromto Nepal

I flew with NIKI this week from Vienna to Alicante and back and it was a great experience Its not expensive return ticket was with checkin luggage which is not bad You also get nice onboard service Sure a sandwich isnt a full meal but its enough and we had rounds of drinks with a selection of coke fanta sprite water and quality juices I also like screens which showed the Big bang theory and our flight info I will fly with them again its great value for money and you keep both your money and your dignity

I simply love Norwegian Its a no nonsense airline that has been incredibly reliable on of the legs that I have recently flown with them Seat pitch is sufficient pricing is fair and predictable and everything just works The service is fine and the onboard menu contains all you need for a few hours in the air I regard them much higher than most old airlines now saying this as a Lufthansa Senator

A short and very pleasant morning flight Efficient boarding airport is small nice seats Professional staff which served water and a sweet Very soft landing All in all a nice experience meeting again the high expectations for AegeanOlympic Air

HKGBKK It was quite a pleasant trip from Hong Kong although delayed an hour They served nice food for breakfast and juice or water or fizzy drink It was an old but clean aircraft The pilots were nice and apologised for delay BKKHKG Delayed hrs mins it was an old Japanese again and the food they served for dinner was chicken with rice orange pudding butter cake and peanuts and a drink Recommend this airline

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

I work on a consumer programme for ITV and would be interested in hearing from anyone who was on the Phuket Air flight which had a reported fuel leak during a routine stop at Sharjah on Sunday rd April We would be interested in hearing your story Please send your contact details using the Comment Form at the bottom of this page and Skytrax will put you in touch with Sarah

Berlin to Moscow You have to pay for anything apart from your personal item That includes your carryon luggage Longest queue at checkin I have seen in years as a result of everybody having to pay for carryon or luggage that was more than kg Aircraft are new and made a good impression Cabin crew young goodlooking and charmingly helpless Seat do not recline

Manchester to Tenerife On the morning of our flight TUI informed us that due to scheduling issues they have enlisted Privilege style as a charter airline The seat was comfortable only issues were my tray table was loose the window was in a position that caused pain on my neck to look out of it The interior felt somewhat tired Apart from this the flight was comfortable and landed safely

ANCFAIANC Economy Open Seating Check in was difficult The checkin agent did not understand how to read my ticket and almost seemed to blame me for the error Once on board however the flight attendants both on the outbound and return were very nice especially on the return flight a definite sense of humor Era offers low fares between Anchorage and Fairbanks and I will be flying with them again Its also nice not to have to go to security when flying on the smaller planes

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service

In spite of a delay of one hour at LHR the flights to and from Australia were the most pleasant that I have made on this route The cabin service is outstanding and my dietary requirements diabetic were met and were some of the best I have ever eaten The cabin crew at all times were top class

Short one hour flights with Safarilink to Diani from Nairobi Wilson return A very pleasant way to reach the coast from Nairobi and much quicker overall than the JKIA Nairobi Airport to Mombasa route Drink and biscuit served Both airports were small indeed Diani is described as an airstrip

We flew from Liberia to San Jose This was an incredibly easy flight We left exactly in time and arrived a few minutes early in San Jose The San Jose Domestic terminal is a very easy and quick experience Absolutely no problems whatsoever I would highly recommend

Tambor to San Jos Regional airline Flight with Cessna clean and flight was on time Very basic airport but the staff were eager to operate it efficient They operate from San Jos domestic terminal which is basic but does the job They are trustworthy and I would recommend them

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

Today traveled from Lahore to Karachi and a pleasant surprise For the first time I could see smiles on the faces of the cabin crew I asked one of the crew members for a coffee and she returned with a cup remembering my seat and not having me to remind her

Flight from Karachi to Islamabad plane flight was pleasant and no turbulence during the whole flight enough leg space to stretch your legs as being a domestic flight there wasnt any entertainment available but the food was excellent Even though the airline is cheaper than other airlines in terms of service and satisfaction it has an edge over its competitors

Pricequality is unbeatable Airplane was on the same standard as most European Airlines and Food and service as well Regarding the transfer in Shenzhen it works perfectly It is a huge modern international Airport I was advised that I could enjoy my time outside the aiport as Austria is one of EU countries that are now Visa free Went to the city with public transport and visited the KK Mall and St Regis Highly recommended Plane was empty that was nice as well

Auckland to Shanghai via Chengdu The food was very good from a Chinese perspective The service was impressive The crew members were nice and passionate Also for transit in Chengdu the passenger is able to claim yuan voucher free hour baggage storage free transit commendation in Chengdu Based on this price you cannot ask more Thank you Sichuan Airlines for the wonderful memory

Singapore to Davao Pretty decent flight with a very well organized crew Happy to serve and with a smile from crew members The style of the seats is a bit old fashioned color of the seats There is no entertainment on the plane but you can connect to the WiFi and get the movies on your device but only if you have the SilkAir app Silk air should let us know in advance before you get a h flight

I recently flew in Singapore airlines Everything about the airline is premium Check in experience the gate allotted to them time performance crew Flying in A was itself unique experience Seating comfort could have been better though otherwise its a out of

This airline is world class and knows how to treat its customers with professionalism and respect Hands down the best airline Ive traveled with and Ive traveled a lot If their standards remain top notch Ill be a customer for life

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar
Flew Tokyo Narita Sapporo Tokyo Narita Flight from Narita was on time while from Sapporo to Narita was delayed for hour Overall flight was ok Ground staff very professional

Flew this airline from Nadi to Honiara and have to give credit it is pretty good The legroom is abundant the crew are efficient with the service Although the airline could benefit from seats with power outlets wifi and IFE Other than that I cannot really fault the airline Gets you across from point a to point b the flight was on time as well

Flew Solomon Airlines from Brisbane to Honiara We boarded to be greeted by smiling attendants The flight was not too full so we had seats to ourselves Leg room was quite good IFE was just a screen panel lowered from the ceiling watched a movie The meal was lunch we had the beef and it was delicious Staff came around to check if we needed any more drinks throughout the flight
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

I have read many negative reviews about this airline so I was not disappointed There was absolutely no service no water was offered no entertainment seats were standard but could not be reclined Checkin was efficient as well as boarding and the most positive point was that the plane left and arrived on time Given the price it was a reasonable option

Ive seen many negative reviews about Sri Lankan airlines However my trip was so good Even though it was a hour flight they provided drinks and a snack which doesnt happen in North America The service was professional too I hope they will grow

KIXHND a stylish airline Cabin staff service efficient Cabin which is coordinated in white and black elegant and personal monitor is easy to use Seats are made of black leather and seat pitch is enough
This airline has impressive cabin staff and a very efficient ground staff never need check in more than minutes before my flight even in Tokyo

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

Travelled again with SunExpresss for a short break to AYT I dont understand the negative reviews as they are totally at odds with every experience I have had with this airline The cabin crew both out and back were fantastic Very friendly polite well groomed and nothing was too much trouble I would not hesitate to travel with them again
The cabin crew was amazing I forgot my earphones near the boarding gate and they found and delivered back to me The flight was LX on March nd Thanks again for a delightful trip

Very satisfactory flights Adequate leg room with blocked off seats Rapid checkin and security Good three course hot meals both ways Swiss had subcontracted to Baltic outbound and Helvetic for the return with little noticeable change in service

My route was GUASALLAX and I like the attention and polite service of the flight attendants During the flight GUASAL operated by E we had candies and the departure and arrival to SAL was on time The service from SAL LAX operated by A and we departed on time The crew were very nice We got our dinner and a movie before the purser shut off the lights to let us sleep and they offered blankets For passengers that didnt sleep the crew offered beverages

Boarding by bus transport Flight on time cabin crew friendly They served water during the short flight Got an emergency exist seat based on my frequent flyer status No entertainment available Landing ahead of schedule Nothing special but effective flight

Its pretty good for a budget airline As long as you have followed predeparture guidelines packed properly and have your passport valid visa and PNR number checkin is easy even if it takes a while for people in front of you to repack their bags as they were NOT prepared or were taking chances with their baggage allowance The rest of the flight was uneventful the crew cabin and seating were efficient beyond what you would expect from a budget airline
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality

CPHHurghadaCPH Flew this airline as part of a charter flightholiday in the Red Sea Both flights I enjoyed immensely Credit for this goes to the cabin crew and their ability to generate such a happy atmosphere in cabin The food quality served was by far the best I have put my teeth into for economy class in more than years of flying around the world On top of this the plane was literally an all new A I had paid a little extra for a few extra centimetres of leg space thumbs up arrival on time at both ends

This was a lovely flight from Hobart to the Gold Coast on Tigerair Boarding was orderly We walked to the plane and boarded through the rear I had row to myself in the second last row I will travel with them again

My sister and I flew from LGW to Banjul I have nothing but praise for the cabin crew We flew out on th Nov at The crew were amazing we have flown many times and although some passengers were difficult they never wavered from the job in hand and seemed to be happy genuinely I wish I took the crews names as they were on the go the whole hrs

Rhodes to Birmingham We would just like to say a big thank you to all the crew on our aircraft from Rhodes to Birmingham that brought us back on the th September due to Thomas cook not trading anymore The staff was so friendly and professional Thank you once again

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route

This company is horrific We had a cancelation of our flight back home and this airline refused to refund our money Fly Maya Island Air They are exceptional less expensive and very flexible The planes are also shady You will not regret flying Maya Island Air Have a wonderful and safe flight
No problem with this airline Pleasant onboard service Schedule respected Aircraft ESSAA leased from an Estonian company Very good experience

I did a round trip with Tunisair in May TunisLondon Gatwick overall impressed by the trip having read the bad reviews before on time good service smooth ride and economy class had well spaced seats as well I cant think of anything bad to say about my experience Hoping Tunisair is getting serious and keeps up providing as good of a service as I had Also very good prices the cheapest next flight was double as I had to pay with Tunisair
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past

I was really impressed with V Air flying from Bangkok to Taipei Easy to use website for booking Smiling staff at check in Very efficient even weighed and tagged cabin baggage Flight lifted off at exact departure time Plane seemed new We didnt preorder food but were able to buy some Cabin crew did a delightful safety demonstration smiling graciously and the passengers applauded Everything spotless efficient thoughtful

Hong Kong to Tokyo Both outbound and inbound flights were ontime Very little or no turbulence experienced during journeys This was very good Checkins at ground were fast and efficient Will choose Vanilla Air again in the future

It was really nice experience this was my first journey with Vistara I am feet height and still I was able to sit comfortably They provided food also after long time get food in Indian domestic flight was a good feel Every days we used to get in jet and kingfisher airlines It was a nice experience now waiting for my connecting flight to Dubai

I have been flying with Volotea for years and have never had any problems I believe that the company is one of the best in existence This is due to all the staff and the company organization Sono anni che volo con Volotea non ho avuto mai problemi Ritengo che la compagnia sia una delle migliori tra quelle in essere Questo merito vs al personale tutto e allorganizzazione aziendale
Good experience The flight assistants have been very kind and I arrived on time The cost of the ticket was really convenient I hope to fly again with them
We were booked on Condor but last minute this flight was changed to Wamos Our experience was very good with this airline The crew was polite and efficient The service and food was very good

The experience is a unique one and I also have a trouble on how to rate this airline We start off from Singapores Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth note that their carryon is only kg we get our boarding pass finish security and customs we finally managed to board the plane the cabin crew was very sweet and nice we are not delayed however the landing was super bad

ADDAMM via Sanaa Overnight in Sanaa where Yemenia provide hotel and breakfast Pleasant flight attendants and acceptable food A good flight and a lot cheaper than competitors I had to change this flight and put it forward by one week which was no problem and didnt cost anything to change

A very nice airy terminal that seems modern enough Free WIFI and free parking Everything within walking distance Most people travel domestic to Copenhagen but a rising number of international routes eg AALAMS makes for a lot of possibilities Checkin is very quick and so is Security All in all a nice experience

The Airport is pretty decent in a lot of aspects The duty free is vast the airport staff and security are ultra professional helped me guide through the terminal on where to find my gate However the WiFi experience could have been better because doing facetime calls was a problem considering whatsapp is not allowed Anyhow it is massive

Was feeling travel sick after arriving Abu Dhabi airport and while waiting for my next flight Starbucks staff were very helpful and called the medic for me and were very helpful Helped me recover within hour Lovely staff

This is a small international airport The personnel are polite helpful and efficient Nearly everyone speaks understandable English and some speak other languages as well Whenever possible I use this airport as my point of entry to Mexico The few options for food and drink are very good and the prices are reasonable

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

This is my home airport so I fly in and out regularly Recent renovations to the central area make it even nicer Fully carpeted soothing music big windows everywhere There is an observation deck open to the public on the nonsecurity side that has good views This is an easy airport in which to get around

Its a relatively small airport I agree with the earlier post about its speediness One of my friends once arrive less than half an hour before his flight departed and was still able to fly out though I wouldnt recommend trying this Overall a very good airport

This is my favorite airport There is rarely a line to check in and check baggage or for security On site airport parking is convenient and reasonably priced After getting through security there is a wide assortment of restaurants and shops along with an aircraft observation lounge There is an abundance of seating in the gate areas and the free airport wifi is very fast Definitely recommend

I was travelling with sight impaired friends Assistance was prebooked with Easyjet I cannot praise the staff highly enough We arrived late at night and we were wheeled very efficiently and cheerfully The staff cared for us very well and made sure we got safely to our taxi

Special assistance staff went above and beyond to help us after huge road delays meant we were late arriving at the airport Cant thank them enough Airport itself was very clean easy to navigate lots of choice for food and drink Fantastic staff

I had to fly from Alicante with a fractured leg The staff and facilities were absolutely amazing Please can you teach Edinburgh Airport how to facilitate and treat disabled passengers Thank you so much Alicante

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

With the media coverage of airport delays we arrived early for our flight Any anxiety quickly disappeared our trip through security was quick and painless The staff were polite efficient and happy Duty free prices were reasonable and toilets and surrounding areas were very clean A good experience

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

First time to this airport When we arrived it was such a pleasant surprise to see how small it was The time from landing to being on the transfer bus was minutes The cases were already waiting after passport control On the return visit it was much busier as several flights were taking off in a short period However they dealt with the people quickly with no issues at all I wish all airports were like this one

I found the airport to be more than adequate We were there in July and it was busy but check in was OK as was security The waiting area is small and there are not enough catering facilities but the roof top terrace was brilliant it was a pleasure to wait for the plane for once and you can have a cigarette in peace The toilets were clean and tidy wastebins emptied frequently so all in all not a bad airport have certainly spent time in much worse

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

Being a frequent traveler to Ancona Airport I have expectations that are met every time Since this airport is so tiny checkin and security are a breeze The single terminal is fairly clean and peaceful The Italian shops have what you expect The only problem I have with this airport is that you cant get coffee in the terminal This isnt much of a problem though because you can simply get it outside There isnt anything wrong with this airport but its not extraordinary It is very relaxed and is a good airport

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home

Used this airport on numerous occasions over the last years Over the last year both domestic and international terminals underwent some renovation and rearrangement of facilities in my opinion for the better Of all facilitiesservices expectable from a midsize regional airport ARH lacks free WIFI coverage and cafes serving hot meals Overall it is a decently wellkept airport which may though benefit from further renovations and improvements

Astana airport is small but very good The staff is ok The wifi connection works pretty well queuing times are very short There is only a few shops in the airport but that seems to be enough for it The exterior and interior design is very good

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

I have been using Bangalore Airport for years and as Indian airports go it has been at the better end of pleasant travel experiences The new Terminal for international flights and some airlines such as Vistara is a revelation amazing feeling of space and the plants on nearly every wall and ceiling give a wonderful effect Security is efficient with minimal queues the or times I have departed There are more and more shops and eateries appearing too

Pretty good airport Nice restaurant shops and post security amenities They recently finished a terminal expansion project which I must say looks very nice Not many cheap airlines though Overall good airport

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

A small airport with all the benefits of that short distances quick security not too crowded Its also quite quick to get into the city Limited flights compared to Belfast International or Dublin but when I have the option Id choose this over the others The business lounge is also very well maintained and spacious plus good food and drink options

Thank you for your kind service My elderly parents flew out and the patience and attention to their comfort was impressive and appreciative They contacted me upon their arrival and both were very calm and satisfied They have been worried about flying days coming into it All that went away at the airport in Bellingham They were greeted upon their arrival at their destination with the necessary extra services Thank you so much

One of Brazils better airports although its design is stark and gloomy though airy Used aforementioned Conexio Aeroporto bus service to get there punctual fast and good quality Food wise all the usual airport restaurants are here but on the third floor to the left is a real find if you want real food and youre on a budget the Restaurante Social looks like a university canteen but serves palatable food at nonairport prices

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

Because of the items in the news about delays and queues we were quite worried about going to Bilbao airport We did have to wait a few minutes at passport control but not too long The airport is a new building very light and modern we didnt have to use any steps at all which was brilliant On our return journey we purchased food and drinks in the cafe they were nicely prepared and the area was very clean and tidy All in all a very good experience and the area can be proud of the facilities

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Busy regional airport with many flights to South Korea Manila and other Philippine airports Airbridges and some remote stands Opened in and relatively modern in terms of layout with level for departures and one for arrivals Speed of baggage retrieval very good and distances from arrival to the carpark opposite the airport very short Free WiFi available

Quiet new airport opened in Check in was efficient Distance to Alona Beach only a few minutes Therefore very comfortable for people staying at the beach There are only few food stalls available Overall a fast and efficient airport

Nothing special to write it looks more like a train station than an airport but its a small city anyway so thats fair Access from the city center by tram makes it the easiest cheapest and fastest airport to reach Ive seen in my life Fans of space will love the huge International Space Station model in the main hall and aviation fans will love the souvenir shop where you can buy many Airbus collectors items One thing they should put more power sockets

Nice little airport Size is adequate for the small number of flights a day Departures and arrivals are separate buildings so it is quick to checkin and collect baggage Departure hall is basically a pergola with a shop and a bar but its fine On arrival you get free trolleys which is a bonus

I have gone to this airport several times the past two years Beside my bad experience with sixt car rental I can not find any reason to complain Friendly and helpful staff check in and security done in minutes Small duty free and nice coffee shop Well functioning small airport

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English

Nice Airport Well organised checkin for B and speedy transit through TSA roomy concourse and nice Buffalo wings There was a fire alarm while we were there which was dealt with with only minor disruption good views of the apron and active runway A good alternative to Toronto for Niagara

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing

Good small airport for a short transit Not as big as NRT which makes it not as daunting Small shopping selection but pretty good food Efficient staff and quick security measures makes transit quite painless

I am sat in a light and airy air conditioned building drinking Cappicino Freddo The queue for checking in was small but very organised and the whole building is welcoming Arrival was just as good although a slight wait for baggage due to three aircraft coming in close together This airport has come on a lot since last year and I recommend it The indicator boards all seem to be working ok and the WiFi is good What more can you want Dont blame the airport for things they dont control

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place
