CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

Very disappointed to see that you are busy aping the western culture and forget our own roots As an Indian I am very proud of my heritage and all my traditional food However Cochin airport is a far cry from that You will happily serve cappuccino coffee to please a foreigner while completely omitting to serve a traditional Indian masala tea or a nice bru coffee It is very sad what Cochin airport has come to

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

My Mom required wheel chair service and we received superb service especially on our departure by Devon He ran to get my Mom as there was a gate change and looked for me as I was getting a snack for her None of the crew advised us but there was Devon with his wonderful smile
Nice clean but crazy expensive food USD for a Cappuccino for a Bnh M Besides that its a nice airport with all facilities you can expect

Whats not to like about DFW You can park at any terminal and take the SkyLink to whichever terminal youre departing from Departure from Terminal E and arrival at Terminal A Parked across from Terminal E United Airlines gates TSAPre took a little bit longer than usual to clear minutes Both Terminals A E are spacious with plenty of shops and dining options Terminals were clean

I first arrived in Damascus in Feb Since then I have been back and forth almost times a year since then I am an Englishman who met and married a Syrian girl in The airport in my view was more relaxed in the old days whereby you could check in and walk back into the loungecafe for tea etc with your friends and family

Im impressed with all the improvements made at Dammam Airport Its easily my favorite airport to fly inout of in Saudi Arabia because of its compact size array of services retail and food and beverage outlets Its website and WiFi connectivity are also quite good and easy to use

I flew into Douala on Swiss and departed on Virgin Nigeria Both experiences were quite pleasant I had only hand luggage and was in and out of the airport quite quickly When departing we waited at the gate which was quite calm and cool Yes its a bit manic as you walk out of the airport with people and noise everywhere but lots of places are like that If you know where you are going or have someone to meet you its fine

I live in Dubai marina and this is a fantastic option to travel from Small quiet check in to boarding in minutes Its still in its infancy before being ramped up to being a hub but it is a joy to use compared to big busy DXB Bags are always office in minutes and you sail through immigration

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

A generally good experience at Durban airport Arrival is quite simple and they seem to keep the touts out of the waiting area The checkin is well organized and immigration outbound proceeded quickly There are a number of shops and restaurants The food and the shopping are forgettable but not expensive Decent amount of seating at the gates Wifi works fine
A fantastic new airport that is miles ahead of the old Durban International Bright spacious and with a feeling of quality

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas

Came to Dushanbe airport at around am for my very early flight to Istanbul The new terminal is small but functional and easy to go through Not plenty to do but the airside cafe is quite nice with good selection and the free wifi was actually quite fast Duty free shop has the typical selection you see everywhere and some local products Plenty of places to sit down unless more than or flights going at the same time its not a very busy airport

Modern airport surprisingly efficient compared with some other internal Russian airports Arrival facilities good baggage on the conveyor without a long wait On departure check in facilities were good security efficient and the Skyteam business lounge was of a high standard with free Internet connection although all drinks etc had to be paid for

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

A rather small airport serving Firenze I used the airport in the winter season so imagine it during the busy summer season Theres bus boarding only and max small gates It has a abundance of dutyfree shops and food beverages counters Prices are reasonable Staff is friendly and efficiently working

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected

I cannot praise enough the airport assistance staff at Girona airport My son has autism and I was wearing the Sunflower Lanyard Assistance staff saw me waiting and came over to me to make themselves know and offer assistance at check in security and boarding the plane Fantastic staff

I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff

Return flights from Glasgow to Verona Check in was quick as was passing through security Facilities were alright bearing in mind our flight was at am Boarding was efficient Return again was stress free other than the automated passport gate refusing to let me through Baggage was already on the carousel when through security All in all a pretty good experience

One of my party fell ill on arrival at the airport an airport attendant was absolutely fantastic she immediately got a wheelchair Helped check in luggage and seen us through check in and security and seen us on the flight safely She could not have done more

Landvetter airport is a rather small one well organized and neat Security checks have seldom long queuing and are generally fast Lots of toilets are available very clean with taps to fillin bottles with water So do not hesitate to pass security with an empty bottle Shopping options are limited as the airport is small but the choice is more than correct This airport seems well managed

Overall I find Guadalajara Airport to be quite user friendly with helpful staff a decent variety of restaurants cafes and shops Security lines are usually efficient and quick Terminals clean and plenty of seating space Several airline lounges and affordable ground transportation options to the city center and nearby areas One of the easiest Mexican airports to navigate

Guayaquil airport is one of the best around The building is modern very functional and easy The staff who work there always are profesional and the most important thing is that you always has a feeling of been safe

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

Previous comments on GPT are no longer true Often GPT is cheaper that New Orleans or any other nearby airport The presence of AirTran keeps fares very reasonable and service is pretty good in all directions The new terminal to be completed this year will be beautiful

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning

The current airport is small but efficient A new much larger terminal is being build Border and security control was fast and efficient All gates are currently in one large terminal with bus boarding only Staff was acting friendly and speedy Bus brings you to to city in for only Lei

Waiting area is too far from the entrance a lot of mosquitos in waiting area as its open crowded too My flight at am and I arrived long hours before my flight in which they decided to let me stay in waiting area overnight and mosquitos enjoying to eat you alive Please do something

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon
Iloilo Airport is one of the best and nicest airports that Ive seen Shopping store and a number of restaurants and coffee shops are also available Really amazing

I arrived at night so it was difficult to be as observant as during the day but baggage came off the conveyor belt within minutes and I obtained a modern car with a very pleasant driver for the transfer to my city hotel the transfer costing P which was reasonable Overall an airport that delivered for me on this trip

Such a small airport but somehow it was still amazing The staff were incredibly nice its not very busy I do think it does need a few more shops there was a fair variety of places to eat Ive never really had an issue with delay we have been delayed a few times but not for very long The flight attendants were kind and the landing was smooth Overall I personally think that it was a magnificent airport and it is very underrated

Massive improvement in airport and staff Very clean public facilities are well maintained Staff are a bit friendlier now and fewer queues on departure and arrival securityimmigration clearance due to having extra staff on counters Just need a few more shops in the terminal

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available

John Wayne airport is a nice little smallhumble airport good for traveling with kids It is a small airport with only gates everything in the airport is close by If you live by John Wayne I definitely would recommend
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel

Love John Wayne Airport it is close and convenient to the I and everything in southern California It is a lot easier to get in and out of than LAX and so much more modern Flew from here to Portland recently and going through security and checking in the bags was a breeze

This is my preferred airport in SoCal for arriving atdeparting from which I do on a regular basis Big enough to offer connections anywhere in the US for flights to Europe yet small enough offer a quick friendly and efficient service tofrom your gate Drop off facilities outside the terminals needs to be improved but apart from that no real complaints
Kaohsiung International airport are one of the best airport to entry Taiwan Now with all the transportation by subway which can easy get from Kaohsiung down town to Kaohsiung airport in mins

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly

Manston is a wonderful airport to fly out of I walked next to my bags as I left the aircraft and collected them withing two minutes The airports size means within another minute I was at the main entrance Departure is wonderful check in was quick despite there only being six desks Within the blink of an eye you are in the departure area Dont expect vast shopping areas or money eating distractions here though

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

Kingston Norman Rogers Airport is the best kept secret of southeastern Ontario I enjoy taking a minute drive to Kingston instead of driving hours to Toronto It is a small terminal building Checkin is quick and easy Air Canada Jazz operated flights daily to Toronto and seasonal service to Montreal using the Dash and Beech D It is worth the connection in Toronto A lot less trouble There are rumours that WestJet is going to be launching daily service to Calgary

I read horror stories and read terrible reviews about Kinshasa FIH Ndjilli Airport I was very nervous about going through there What a lovely surprise awaited me A brand new terminal clean bright air conditioned well a big plus in Africa all employees well dressed and polite Procedures took time and were very detailed but nothing out of the ordinary You dont really need to pay a VIP service to go through you will be OK on your own Make sure all your travel documents and stay details ready for inspection

Fast efficient little airport to arrive at your luggage arrives quickly and is usually carefully handled It is almost impossible to get lost and the airport has good transport links for Carinthia and the ski regions of NW Slovenia Flying from Klagenfurt is not quite so good the departure lounge could do with some toilets after passport control so if you need the toilet be sure to go before you go through On the positive side the cafe upstairs is very good for the size of airport
Brilliant little airport with thoughtful touches such as free snacks and water Only downside was the open air departure lounges so no air conditioning ie humidity very high

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price
Small but very pleasant Nice staff and decent facilities Better than any of the larger airports

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

Overall very pleasant experience Landed in Terminal Kuwait Airways Holding on to a Singapore passport and it took me just mins to have my evisa stamp Very efficient Custom clearance done under mins and luggage out right on time I was out of the airport in mins Departure from Terminal Qatar Airways fuss free Few DFS stores and cafes Not much options but all good

The airport is very nice and average The check in is a bit slow Be at the airport terminal at least hours prior to the flight The arrivals is busy and crowded The washrooms are wet and needs improvements The airport needs more duty free shops The WIFI and connectivity is very fast and quick to connect

The current airport consists of two buildings The first houses the security scanners and the second an open air thatched building the manual check in Very pleasant for small groups A new terminal is being constructed and should be ready in a few years Like most things in Lamu this is a simple functional relaxed airport From the terminal you walk meters to the fast boats for the minute ride to Lamu Town or to Shela Beach
No boarding bridges But views are very nice Not much wait for luggage The ground service is good

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport

Really pleasant and convenient airport Minimal queues and pleasant staff A really nice touch is the free coffee tea and newspapers for all passengers in the departure lounge I just wish that the runway was long enough to permit direct flights from the UK to land here

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job
Easy to get to with car from the Autobahn or from Leipzig with the train The airport is large but not confusing or crowded Security was a breeze All the people seemed nice

Ive flown in and out of BJX a half dozen times and have no problems Take along a book or knitting as there are only a couple of souvenir shops but they are colorful and reasonable My destination has been San Miguel de Allende the art colony thats popular with US citizens

This is a small and nice airport Ive landed and departed from this airport before and it has changed a lot I dont know why it is called Leon Airport if it is closer to Silao Gto I landed there a few months ago my destination was Romita Gto my mothers hometown This airport is very convenient for us since it is only about mins away from Romita Also this airport is not very far from Guanajuato city I recommend people to visit Guanajuato this is perhaps the most European style city in Mexico

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Lovely airport amazing views of the Alps Checkin was ok Wizz airline desks were poorly managed with long ques but the rest of the airlines seemed fine and so was security Shops were a bit lacking but overall a good airport

Excellent little airport A bit tired cosmetically but everyone was friendly and everything worked seamlessly Dont rush through security unless youre desperate to look at aeroplanes as theres not much else to do Theres a little smoking box that takes people after security next to gate upstairs Its free and the ventilation works well

It is simply an airport and not trying to be a shopping mall or anything else Very quick passage through the airport if youre only dropping off bags TSA efficient but thorough bit of a crowd in the north portakabin as JetBlue DL and AS had simultaneous departures but as you can turn up so close to departure its not a long wait Restaurant upstairs is good as well though not cheap and it would be good to have more of the balcony given to noneaters maybe its busier midweek than on a Sunday afternoon

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

The addition of the new Southwest wing has been a good improvement for all those who enjoy flying on this airline Flying out of this airport has been very convenient because of its location for many Long islanders especially those living in Suffolk and eastern Nassau counties The one drawback to the Southwest facility expansion is the distance from their new gates to the baggage claims area
Once again I used Lviv Airport four times in August Very satisfied with facilities and staff who work there Definitely beats many USA airport who have a lot to do in order to improve

A brand new airport which is large and spacious but lacking in facilities Our gate was in an area where there is no catering and no access to a part of the airside where we could even get a coffee Staff are not all that friendly here but it seems to be efficient with little queuing though not all the many flights either

What a pleasant airport easy check in good facilities cool and well organised As enjoyable as an airport experience can be This was in complete contrast to our home airport of Bristol UK Everything seemed so well organised and customer focused
I would like to thank Alessandra at the customer services desk for the phenomenal service and friendliness she has provided me at the airport She is an absolute gem

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing

Optimal infrastructure parking is good the check in is very fast thoughtful attendants the security is good The airport has a lack of restaurants that is somewhat annoying but has a good service and good wifi

Traveled to Manaus many times found the airport good with easy access to car park Staff nice security not too long a queue shops etc are standard airport stuff Would recommend early arrival and double check all documentation you need to travel Stop to look at the turtles outside the terminal in their own pond

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

I must say I was quite surprised with this relatively new airport It is well designed and all checkin security and boarding processes were very efficient The free wifi connection is probably one of the best services Ive experienced so far The choice of dining and shopping are also very good The airport itself is quite far from the city but there is a train service to the city
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite
The airport services were very attentive to the plane we arrived at local time when we left the plane the luggage gang was already in operation and the suitcases were in very good condition

First time arriving in this beautiful country together with wife for umrah Arrived by Malaysia Airlines A and departure with same aircraft Facilities well kept staff welcome us with a smile Easy flow for arriving and departing

Arriving at Miami International Airport to return to Rome we had the invaluable assistance at the automatic checkin before the Air Canada desk so I dont think an Air Canada employee helped us so much to understand how we had to make our boarding passes and what to do with our luggage Thanks to him the passage through this airport seemed delightful

This is possibly one of the nicest airports Ive flown through Staff were amiable the terminals were clean and wellmaintained and everything was wellmarked Security was a breeze and the baggage claim system is both swift and efficient compared to other airports

One of my favorite airports to make a connection through Ive flown through MKE maybe times or so and never have had to wait in a line to go through security There is also a very nice bookstore decent food options nice play areas for kids and an aviation museum The airport is also fairly stress free for making connections

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

We travelled through Monastir Airport and found it to be pretty good for a small airport The queues coming in were fairly smooth and on the way out of the country everything went smoothly as well Facilities are perhaps a little limited but its only a small airport comparatively and at least it was clean

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

I cant say that Domodedovo is very good airport staff is ok good business lounges the standard Russian duty free Cosmetics and snacks I think it is nice because of business security check and passport control

Transfer from international to domestic flight and back last week My flight from London arrived into Terminal D and transferred to Terminal B for the domestic departure Efficient experience overall clear signage but some long walking distances from arrival to the shuttle train Terminal B has a nice interesting design and plenty of seats with chargers Nice selection of lounges for cardholders Overall recommended

Its development in the last years is rather impressive More than one million passengers now use this airport each year for a regional airport this is rather much I think I like she short distances the easy and quick checkin services the nice environment and the very close parking facilities I you arrive at this airport you have to wait never longer than min for the luggage delivery

Mumbai Airport never fails to impress me from the dedicated drop off options or the overall efficiency It is my favourite major airport to travel from I am more impressed with arrival facilities but even departure is as good as it gets Only fundamental issue is its very overcrowded
A pleasant small airport very useful for southern Spain A minus point would be being held in the sun before boarding a plane this is quite unpleasant Announcements are very clear Very good airport

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

We were delayed for nights due to bad weather on the th and th January The staff at Mytilene Airport in Lesbos were excellent they kept a smile during a very difficult time for them We were given a voucher for food and drinks each time our flight was cancelled times in all and they sent us to very good hotels both nights In addition when we asked if they could extend our journey for the days that we had lost they did with no problems

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

Over the years have had the pleasure of travelling through this airport surely the best planned facility of its size anywhere in the world Maybe all wouldbe new airport planners should pay Norfolk a visit to see what a well designed airport should look like and thats not even mentioning the surrounding beautiful botanical gardens a very pleasant change from the usual grimy industrial areas adjoining most airports

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

A small airport where you can go from the luggage checkin to the gate within minutes There were enough places to sit down and the WiFi is good If you want to eat something before the security there is a restaurant with enough food pricequality top After the security you can also drink or eat something Boarding goes quickly

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

I really like this airport it is small and not complicated It is really clean and they have a small but nice section for kids to play Just wish there were more restaurant for the US side There are usually no delays The airport is a bit far from downtown so a bit expensive in taxi but hey they have Uber and lot of parking space

A first class airport with a good range of facilities There does not seem to be the usual hectic atmosphere of most airports bringing back the pleasure into flying Decent food at non ripoff prices particularly recommend the caferestaurant on the mezzanine floor

PSP is a beautiful airport in the secured area However the checkin to the security point is a long walk for the many retired people that travel through this airport The open air feeling is great in this warm climate The biggest negative is that when there is poor weather and those times are few is the lack of technology for pilots to land During a rain storm and low visibility we were delayed minutes while circling and then continued to Los Angelos then bussed back to Palm Springs

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Transited twice in November without problems Signage is good distances are large even within terminal e No problems either time though timings were circa an hour and a half Security check each time but fairly fast and efficient

Paro International Airport is located meter above sea level so flights can only fly in the morning I took a Druk Air flight from Bangkok and the other time I took a flight from Kathmandu I prefer flying from Kathmandu because I could see Himalayan Mountains if the weather permits Paro Airport has very basic amenities because they have two carriers flying in and out It replicated Bhutanese traditional architecture and it looked very beautiful as I was walking into the airport

Ive flown in and out of Pau several times Its a lovely airport with a pleasant smallness about it The only downside for me is that from the UK it is only served by Ryanair On principle I will no longer fly with them If any other UK carrier starts using Pau I will happily fly there again

A lovely little airport Ample parking right in front I was happy because I could find a seat in the waiting area no small matter Toulouse is closer to the area where we vacation but the trip peagemajor highway makes travel easy and fast and the national and local roads are good too

The airport is small and modern It has both local and international flights Air France Arrivals are no problem and there is not far to walk from the aircraft to the airport exit There did not seem to be to many people bothering passengers Departures is also straight forward with modern checkin desks There are not many shops in the departure area and only one basic cafe There is adequate seating and the airconditioning works well Overall a very good experience compared with other African airports

A quiet afternoon at PDX Short queues to get through security with efficient and helpful staff As the space allocated for security was fairly small I can imagine at that at busy times there could be problems
The checkin and security were very quick One bottle of water was quite expensive This is a very nice but quite small airport and there isnt much choice where to go but it was OK for me
When I got out of the plane there was no bus shuttle to the terminal but this is understandable because of the Coronavirus Border control was fast and my experience at the airport was pleasant

Back to Pristina in February The airport now has a proper baggage reclaim and is looking a little more finished The departure lounge has another shop and increased size It is still best to use the bar before immigration Overall this is still a good little airport

Whats not to like about TF Green Airport It was recently ranked the d best airport by Travel Leisure readers Its newly remodeled bathrooms are like those of a star hotel Going through TSAPre was a breeze Cleared security in less than minutes Distances from security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly This used to be my home airport before I relocated to the Dallas area and it remains one of my favorite airports to fly through

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

The Puerto Princesa International Airport had just opened its new terminal The terminal was clean and brand new The airport terminal had no jet bridge or ramp stairs so we had to deplane via an old fashioned staircase at the mercy of the weather thankfully at that time it was already dark The airport lacks formal transportation to the city center although the city streets is just a mere minutes walk away Definitely one of the best provincial airports in the Philippines if you consider dirt runways the norm

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people
It was perfect I love everything about thr airport It was quick and has good staff Good food and its modern Just love it but I dont like the national airlines like TAME

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

One member of our party has special needs and requires the special assistance service The airport ground staff were exemplary We travel regularly The assistance kindness efficiency and responsiveness of all the ground staff we encountered was the best that we have experienced I would recommend Rhodes airport as an airport with staff that genuinely assist those with special and additional needs

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

I have arrived with pretty bad expectations after reading the reviews here but every single person was so kind to me that I had to come back to leave a positive review Absolute pleasant surprise correct exchange rates that Im not used to clean easy to navigate staff super kind and respectful I am happy that my experience was different from others

A supposedly international city airport and in the huge transit area the managers dont even manage to install a few water fountains for cool refreshing water for tired and thirsty travellers especially those with children What an appalling omission It is a shame really as in most other respects the airport is very pleasant
Riyadh airport is a nice airport We had to transit from there and were surprised to see that how beautiful is even their domestic terminal

This little airport is very nice and adapted to the demand and number of passengers There was only one cafe but with nice food and drinks Because of the small numbers of passengers traveling through that airport there was absolutely no waiting I would defenitly go there again

A small little provincial airport can be a touch uncomfortable in hot weather as the large glass windows absorb the sun as you wait in the departure area One small cafe serving reasonable food and drink Check in quick and car hire points convenient to main entrance Good main road access to the town of Rodez and Tarn and Tarn et Garonne etc

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

As I live nearby its a convenient airport for me especially because of frequent flights to London and Southern France You can make use of free Internet Parking is cheap Connection to Rotterdam City and Port area is good and quick Hardly any queuing you can arrive mins before departure without any problems Whenever possible I make use of RotterdamThe Hague Airport

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

I am delighted to share my exceptional experience with Officer Lucas at San Francisco International Airport His assistance in locating my lost phone and guiding me to the correct boarding gate was invaluable Not only did he ensure I found my belongings but he also took the time to ensure my wellbeing before departing I am sincerely grateful for his kindness and assistance

Our flight arrived very late and the hotel shuttle stopped running Bryce was very kind to help us find transportation to our hotel He went above and beyond his job to make sure we arrived safely I was very satisfied

Used this airport several times over the past decade at various times of the day and on long and short haul flights A small pleasant airport where it is usually possible to find a quiet corner Staff are helpful and usually smile Dining is American fast food variety and expensive Pay the departure tax in advance at your hotel Avoid the postsecurity shopping as the prices are high
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe yuan But what I really love is the waiting area outside
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

Being in this airport was so much fun From the royce chocolate factory to different shopping areas there are lots of thing to do I arrived hours early but still did not have enoungh time to explore the airport The immigration was systemized and there were almost no lines Although it is not a star airport I think it has to be one of the best in the world

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

Saskatoon airport is small and simple to get around The signs pointing to the right place are just perfect Renovations were being done at this time but it was still super easy to be there and get to my flight on time

It is a privilege to be able to travel via GMP in Seoul Not because the airport is extraordinary but because it is within the city of Seoul and much closer then the island of Incheon GMP can be be reached by metro It is a domestic and an international airport the international connections are through towards Asian destinations GMP has the Advantages and the disadvantages of an old city airport easy to reach more efficient security procedures but old facilities like lounges
The best assistance so far for arrival and departure For someone who has less mobility and needs a wheel chair Superb and faster assistance Everything in place on time

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient
The pleasant experience of arriving and departure in Shannon Airport was above all else Efficiency professionalism courteous Dublin needs to take a look and see how its done Well done Shannon

Beautiful terminal and concourses in the new terminal Light and airy honestly the airport I would most enjoy waiting around in for a flight delay Also good food and shops and a general uplifting feeling Also the bus transit link back to Hong Kong was fast and efficient Going through security screening was a bit of a line but the check procedure was quick enough

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

I experienced the best customer service at Skopje Airport During security I found out that my phone was missing I left my phone at the selfservice check in machine on the other side of security But they helped me out They called their colleagues and eventually found it brought it back to me I felt trustful through the whole process and really really het Thanks a lot

The airport is small yet very well organized There is every service available that a person would require even for a long wait restaurant ATMs banks PO as far as airport seats go I was able to sleep on these in more comfort than others Ive been through many airports and can honestly say that Im impressed

From the city to the airport in minutes The new terminal is fine Beautiful geometric lines used in the design Checkin for flight did not take too long The old building renovated and converted into a zone of local flights There are many shops and cafes There was a small queue of precontrol before departure

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

I cant remember when the last time I was here but nevertheless it was a pleasant surprise to use the airport again Many places to have food and the atmosphere was pleasant Just one thing that I disliked was the toilet in the common area It was really smelly and should be dealt with immediately

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

We had quite a lot of time to kill in this airport and it didnt disappoint There was a restaurant right in the middle of the terminal that was delicious and decently priced Unfortunately the wifi was not working no matter how many times we tried but they had this nice area called the library we sat in that was pleasant and helped the time pass

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone
There is very good food and Wifi Internet The dutyfree shop has all kinds of brands and it is cheaper than neighboring countries The immigration inspection is fast and not difficult

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much
Good airport no delays it was fairly quiet when I travelled Security and passport checks all done efficiently Staff were polite and helpful

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum
Phenomenal airport the best I ever experienced in Europe or anywhere else Just the material definition of how an airport should be Well done Albania

Haneda is a nice airport but immigration is hell long lines clearly show the Japanese slowness to adapt to any increase of the of arrival If you fly in while low traffic It is one of the best airport but not today as I will be losing minutes to pass immigration

The little airport is getting a lot more traffic and starting to burst at the seams Even though the rail connection is a good piece of news the amount of people in the transit area isnt But still it beats Stansted queuing and even Ryanair checkin is fairly straight forward
Little airport very nice Not many dining choices not very important for me because it was a late flight Fast boarding procedure Pleasant view of the tarmac
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge
Very good airport Satisfied with all aspects of airport Best airport in Kerala Lots of new shops are opening on the airport I am sure this airport will make to top airports in India

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

Well organised for the transit process Airport service persons picked us up at the exit and allocated us in a special area There are free services for water wifi access and breakfast A lady registers and reminds each of the customers in the waiting area for boarding Very good experience

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

Wenzhou Airport is for me one of best airports in China The New terminal is very big and very beautiful the checkin security check and boarding is fast and easy At this airport they start the automatic checkin and it is fantastic and very simple The airport staff are kind and happy to serve you
The new terminal is really fresh and at the domestic departure some airlines merge in the same area and you can check in at any queue Everything looks good

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by
I really love this airport It is small and very quick Regular security is quicker than TSA Pre The Airport has nice entertainment and its a nice regional airport

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

This was a ok flight At the airport my bag got stuck on the baggage belt and then a worker hit it really hard but thankfully I had nothing that fragile in it When we were boarding there was a delay because a seat was stuck reclined and they had to bring an engineer onboard The flight was very smooth and the cabin crew were very nice although not as nice as their biggest competitor Ryanair The landing was really good and the pilot kept giving us information about the flight

Cascais to Bragana with Aero VIP Services are provided by SevenAir The site is easy I had a couple of questions and the support was fantastic The plane was just fine despite being a propeller thus a bit noisy

Flew AR on various segments in November Rio de Janeiro GIG to Buenos Aires Buenos Aires Puerto Madryn rt and Buenos Aires Barilcohe rt using both AEP and EZE in Buenos Aires Pleasant experience on all flights All flights departed on time boarding process was well organized crews were courteous and complimentary drinks and a snack were served in economy No issues with checked luggage Would certainly fly them again

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

Excellent flight good service with hearty meal starter main course dessert tea and coffee Duty service on board A generous pitch for economy class seats Note the delay at departure due to the closure of Orly airport and the flights diverted to Paris CDG

My first experience with this regional airline on a short hop from PointaPietre to Melville Hall Very pleasant and relaxed flight nice staff and decent leg and hand luggage space Will be happy to fly with them at any time again

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

Paris to Reunion Air Austral is a fairly good airline The seat layout of the Airbus A was xx The leg room was not too bad Inflight entertainment was good and worked well Cabin service was average but generally fine The flight was on time

Flew internal flights in Burma with this local airline Surprisingly new plane pretty much on time and with very pleasant crews Also served a good snack gave out towels although flights were only about minutes Was a bit reticent about using them but very pleasantly surprised

Flew on four separate legs within Myanmar and found them to be surprisingly good You dont normally expect catering on flights of under an hour but there was something on all segments Arrived in good time at Heho Airport for a flight to Yangon and they automatically put me on to an earlier departure There is a certain amount of third world amateurism about the boarding process but it all seemed to work
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

Apart from the fact that the crew at Incheon were a little rude everything was perfect For a low cost airline the seats were very comfy and the legroom was amazing I would definitely recommend this airline

Reykjavik to Akureyri I have never been on a friendlier serviced aircraft than this Absolutely wonderful flight only minutes and quite a unique experience on a propeller plane Absolutely love the onboard travel journal where you can read other passengers adventures and write your own in very sweet Would love to fly with them again next time Im in Iceland

Milan to Male Nice airline Very good in all services Economy class is a very good class Beverages are very good too with a lot of product On my flight services were snack lunch and a afternoon snack with a slice of pizza If you need something else you can ask to steward that will help you in every moment Staff is very kind and happy Good airline

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

Heho to Yangon Another very good flight same ATR aircraft no seat numbers given but all very easy boarding Plenty of space seating and inflight snacks given with coffee or Tea One member of crew not happy but not the end of the world At I had no problem with the seat space in fact better than many European airlines

Pyongyang to Beijing with hotcold drinks and a hamburger which was adequate for length of flight Very polite and welcoming service Efficient check in and boarding In flight entertainment limited to a video of recent North Korean hits Pyongyang Times and Korea Today available to take on board

Easy check in at Gatwick They use the club rooms lounge which was fine Prompt boarding and beverage served One hour delay managed well by crew who served further drinks and snacks During flight beverage good There is a strong emphasis on fish in meals It was fine I just dont like fish Slept well on lie flat mattress topper was very good Breakfast good their orange juice was excellent Easy disembarking and luggage off quickly
The aircraft was on time from Manchester and on the return journey from Lourdes Bartres the aircraft left early The staff were a bit distant the food good overall OK
A decent enough job on a very full flight They got me there from A to B without frills or fuss I liked the onboard Kiwi Qui that they ran during the flight a nice and quirky touch

Air New Zealand short haul is brilliant The crew service was brilliant There was also a quiz on the plane for the whole flight Very quick flight time after the plane was late coming in from the previous destination Brilliant quick flight
The airline was fantastic Left and arrived on time You get a snack provided by the airline Very tasty Would always choose to fly with Air North in the future

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

Panama City to David Pleasant flight experience on an old Fokker A little expensive for what you get but theres little competition in Panama Seats were comfortable spacious though the interior of the plane had not seen an update since the late s or early s Cabin crew were friendly and served soft drinks including diet options and plantain chips Flight departed and arrived about min late

Amazing team at Hubli airport We had to change the plane in Bangalore to get to Kochi and we might be late however the team assured us that our baggage will go first from plane when we have landed Us and few other people in similar situation were brought by small bus faster than other customer to the airport and one guy from airport in Bangalore from Air Pegasus made sure and check our flights details that we will be on time Thank you one more time especially for team in Hubli Amazing customer service

Living and working in South Africa I fly home to Zimbabwe fairly often and try to be patriotic and use the national airline I have only been delayed once in the past year Food is good and service also of acceptable standards Ggetting through to the Joburg offices is another story altogether overall I think Air ZIm are doing the best they can with the resources at their disposal

I would like to write about the splendid service given to me my spouse by Air Asia AK Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar on Friday Im so proud to mention about these two cabin crew Ms Camelia Mr Amirul Their love and care is still lingering in our mind Kudos to Air Asia to have them in their crew family Our most sincerest gratitude Love you guys a lot our best wishes in your future
Special appreciation to the cabin crew Sonika I was super impressed with her fluency in announcements all three different languages and it was just amazing to hear her out
Airline staff helped me with last minute web check in cancellation also helped locating the luggage and provided the best support and service for such hospitality and customer delight
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky
I was super impressed with this airline Highly recommend it for travel within Africa Im not sure what else to say Glad airlink is available now for travel in Africa
Everything about the flight experience went well I was worried reading the other reviews but in the end it was a very positive experience The terminal in El Nido is also very good
